big_case.notes: Emergency election-administration stay application by New Hampshire state officials (Secretary of State and Attorney General) invoking Purcell v. Gonzalez two weeks before the November 2026 midterm general election, resolved via full-Court referral and grant with a noted dissent by Justice Jackson. While election-eve Purcell rulings draw national doctrinal attention and RNC amicus participation, the injunction and stay were substantively confined to New Hampshire's executive guidance on whether student IDs may be considered alongside other evidence under statutory voter-ID safety valves, leaving the underlying voter-ID statute (HB 323) untouched.
